answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48183 Country: India Title: Baby boy name Question: Is it allowed to keep the name of baby boy as "Aryan", is it Islamic name? Answer ID: 48183 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1399/L=454/TL=11/1434) ‘Aryan’ is not a name; hence it is not better to keep such name. وفى الفتاوي: التسمية باسم لم يذكره الله تعالى فى عباده ولا ذكره رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا استعمله المسلمون تكلموا فيه والأولى أن لا يفعل (عالمگیری 5/362) You should choose any of the below mentioned names instead of Aryan: Usman, Affan, Salman, Sufiyan etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
